expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical cards side by side (Green Bowl Poké, 15–25 min, €0.90 delivery, same image). This looks like a duplicated data entry or a rendering bug, and it wastes prime space in the carousel.
Secondary text is light gray on a white or light background (delivery fees, the search placeholder, inactive tab labels, the '(500+)' rating count). Its contrast is low and may fall below WCAG AA.

The time badges on the carousel cards overlap the bottom-left corner of the image and sit tight against the card edge. On the first cards the badge also partially overlaps the bowl image, which looks slightly cramped.
The favorite heart buttons sit on busy image backgrounds with a semi-transparent dark circle. The button is barely distinguishable on the dark ramen image and inconsistent with the pizza card.
